snippet.description:
Is This Ancient Carving Proof of Lost Technology? Look What They Found in Ancient Wall.

An intriguing ancient carving reveals a strangely designed object with a rounded upper section, detailed patterns, and unusual side features. The craftsmanship makes this ancient scene especially fascinating, leaving us to wonder what the original creators intended to portray.

Was it a symbolic design, a ceremonial object, or something completely different? The meaning behind this mysterious carving remains open to interpretation.

What do you think this ancient carving represents?

snippet.description:
Meet G. Babu Sir, the Polity & Governance faculty at LevelUp IAS, who has cracked the UPSC Civil Services Examination 4 times.

In this short, Santosh Sir highlights Babu Sir’s remarkable UPSC journey, followed by feedback from rankers on his Polity classes and notes. And then comes the correction: “I cracked UPSC four times, not thrice.” 🔥

If you're preparing for UPSC CSE 2028, learn Polity & Governance from a teacher who has repeatedly experienced the exam process himself.
